strategies.traps:
• Detail Traps: Options true in reality but not supported by passage.
• Half-Right Traps: First half correct, second half flawed.
• Extreme Words: Words like 'always', 'never', 'completely'.

strategies.core_rules:
• Total 44 Questions (22 per module), 70 minutes total.
• Domains: Algebra (35%), Advanced Math (35%), Problem-Solving & Data Analysis (15%), Geometry & Trig (15%).
• Desmos Graphing Calculator permitted for ALL math questions.
strategies.traps:
• Unit Conversion Traps: Forgetting to convert minutes to hours or cm to m.
• Question Prompt Traps: Solving for x when asked for x + y or 2x.
• Extraneous Solutions: Forgetting to check roots in radical/rational equations.

strategies.core_rules:
• Use Continuers (+/+), Contradictors (+/-), or Cause/Effect clues.
• Predict a simple word before looking at choices.
• Watch for secondary academic meanings of common words (e.g., 'register', 'compromise').
strategies.traps: • Choosing common definitions instead of context-specific academic meanings.

strategies.core_rules:
• Textual Evidence: Match exact claim with specific line or quotation.
• Quantitative Evidence: Read graph/chart axes and key carefully before evaluating choices.
strategies.traps: • Selecting options that are true according to the graph but irrelevant to the thesis.

strategies.core_rules:
• Semicolon = Period = Comma + FANBOYS (nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập).
• Colon (:) used after complete sentence to introduce list, explanation, or quote.
• Match Subject-Verb agreement by striking out intervening prepositional phrases.
strategies.traps: • Comma Splices: Nối 2 mệnh đề độc lập chỉ bằng dấu phẩy.

strategies.core_rules:
• Parallel lines = No solution (m1 = m2, b1 != b2).
• Same line = Infinitely many solutions (m1 = m2, b1 = b2).
• Look for opportunities to add/subtract equations to find target expressions directly.
strategies.traps: • Solving for individual variables when the prompt asks for an expression like x + y.

strategies.core_rules:
• Vertex form y = a(x - h)^2 + k -> Vertex at (h, k), max/min = k.
• Vieta's Formulas: Sum of roots = -b/a, Product of roots = c/a.
• Remainder Theorem: Remainder of P(x) / (x - c) is P(c).
strategies.traps: • Sign errors when identifying vertex coordinates from equation.
